$comment: Library catalog (R-LIB-6). The single source of what Jjodel shares, until an administration service replaces this file with the same schema. kind: sealedNotation (case 1, a complete language used through the model editor only) or galleryProject (case 2, a project the user clones and owns). status: planned (decided, not built), available (built, its package under frontend/public), deferred (decided for later). publisher is always jjodel until R-LIB-3 opens the gallery to others. description (optional): the one line the Templates page shows under a galleryProject. Version 2 (R-LIB-9): a galleryProject has a tier (template: a small didactic project teaching one concept, with one hand-written viewpoint; example: a complete case of a whole language), its current version n and its versions, each with file (under frontend/public), published date, sha256 of the file and notes. A published version is never rewritten: a fix is a new version. Its deep link is #/templates/<id>@<n>, or #/templates/<id> for the current version. Since R-LIB-19: level (beginner, intermediate or advanced), concepts (slugs of a closed vocabulary: containment, inheritance, references, enumerations, validation, multiple-metamodels, simulation, code-generation), an optional callout (the amber note of the card) and preview (<id>/<n>.preview.png under frontend/public/library/gallery/, written by the snapshot script; the card paints its dot grid alone while the file is missing). The counts of metamodels and models are read from the package, never written here.
